defects.title: A rules input leaves the grRules and rxnGeneMat entries of the new reactions empty
defects.trigger: m = createModel({'R1','R2'}, {'',''}, {'a[c] -> b[c]', 'b[c] -> '}, 'grRuleList', {'g1',''}, 'printLevel', 0); m2 = addMultipleReactions(m, {'N1','N2'}, {'a[c]','b[c]'}, [1 0; -1 1], 'rules', {'x(1)', ''}) (also with 'genes', {'g9';'g1'})
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-25) m2.rules = {'x(1)';'';'x(1)';''} but m2.grRules = {'g1';'';'';''} and full(m2.rxnGeneMat) = [1;0;0;0]: line 186 empties the new grRules and line 222 reads model.rules (the input model, never extended) instead of newmodel.rules, so the grRules/rxnGeneMat update of lines 224-244 is unreachable (line 228 would also read the input model's genes)
defects.expected: grRules and rxnGeneMat rows of the new reactions agree with the given rules (comment of line 220; the grRules input does this)

defects.title: Reaction IDs already in the model, or repeated in rxnIDs, are added a second time
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-25) first call warns 'The following reaction IDs are already IDs of variables in the model: R1' and returns rxns {R1,R2,R1,N2}; second returns {R1,R2,N1,N1} silently. Line 97 exist('varargin','var') is always true, so the recovery of lines 100-115 is dead; the duplicate-ID errors were replaced by this warning in commit 9fd8de21ea (2020)
defects.expected: reaction IDs stay unique (existing IDs rejected or skipped as lines 100-115 intend; repeated IDs rejected as repeated metabolites are at line 120)

defects.title: A rules input without genes stops on a model without a rules field
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-25) error 'Unrecognized field name "rules".' at line 222 (lines 211-212 create newmodel.rules, line 222 reads model.rules)
defects.expected: the reactions are added with the rules created at lines 211-212

notes: Reproduction: m = createModel({'R1','R2'}, {'',''}, {'a[c] -> b[c]', 'b[c] -> '}, 'grRuleList', {'g1',''}, 'printLevel', 0); m2 = addMultipleReactions(m, {'N1','N2'}, {'a[c]','b[c]'}, [1 0; -1 1], 'rules', {'x(1)', ''}); m2.grRules, full(m2.rxnGeneMat) -> grRules of N1 empty, rxnGeneMat row 3 zero while rules{3} = 'x(1)'. m4 = addMultipleReactions(m, {'R1','N2'}, {'a[c]','b[c]'}, [1 0; -1 1]); m4.rxns -> {R1,R2,R1,N2}. Call forms for the quarantine scope: defects 1 and 3 need the 'rules' name/value input, which no src caller passes (grep of addMultipleReactions calls with 'rules': none; only testBatchAddition uses it, and asserts rules only, not grRules). Defect 2 is reached by any caller whose rxnIDs contain an ID already in the model or a repeat (depends on data, not recognisable in the calling code). testBatchAddition lines 128-129 expect errors for a repeated ID and an existing ID ('CS'), but both calls fail earlier at line 79 because metabolite 'c' is not in that model, so the legacy test does not detect defect 2. testBatchAddition is a multi-function legacy test (addMultipleReactions, addMultipleMetabolites, addGenes), so a new file was written (precedent: testAddGenes). Not a defect of this function: a reaction field that is not a defined COBRA field is excluded with a warning when numel(rxns) == numel(mets) (getModelFieldsForType cannot tell its type); with distinct sizes it is appended. The grRules path (changeGeneAssociation after the 2026-11-25 fix), defined-field creation via createEmptyFields and the error branches behaved as documented in probes.
confirmed_by: lead, 2026-11-25: code read (addMultipleReactions: exist(varargin) always true, so lines 100-115 never run; line 222 reads the old model.rules; addMultipleReactionsIT is byte-identical; addReaction: line 183 reads the legacy subSystem field, so line 307 resets subSystems; metaboliteList without stoichCoeffList has no default), writer reproduced each in MATLAB; default reach (the duplicate-ID and subSystems defects depend on data, not on the call form; 1 of 119 addReaction calls passes subSystem)

defects.title: A metaboliteList without stoichCoeffList stops instead of using coefficients -1
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-25) error 'Index exceeds array bounds.' at line 341: the stoichCoeffList default is [] (lines 173, 203)
defects.expected: every coefficient -1, as the help of stoichCoeffList states

defects.title: Changing an existing reaction erases its subsystem
defects.trigger: m = createModel({'R1','R2','R3'}, {'','',''}, {'a[c] -> b[c]', 'b[c] -> ', 'c[c] -> '}, 'grRuleList', {'g1','',''}, 'printLevel', 0); m.subSystems{1} = {'Glyc'}; r = addReaction(m, 'R1', 'lowerBound', -5)
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-25) r.subSystems{1} = {''} while lb, grRule and metabolites of R1 are kept; the subsystem default is read only from the legacy field subSystem (lines 183-185), so the default {''} (line 170) is written at line 307. Same with 'reactionFormula' on an existing reaction
defects.expected: an existing reaction keeps its subsystem unless subSystem is given, like its other fields (lines 178-196)

defects.title: rxnIDexists holds the position of the identical reaction, not its ID
defects.trigger: m = createModel({'R1','R2','R3'}, {'','',''}, {'a[c] -> b[c]', 'b[c] -> ', 'c[c] -> '}, 'grRuleList', {'g1','',''}, 'printLevel', 0); [r, ex] = addReaction(m, 'N1', 'reactionFormula', 'a[c] -> b[c]', 'checkDuplicate', true)
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-25) ex = 1 (double, index of R1); warning 'Model already has the same reaction you tried to add: R1'; model unchanged
defects.expected: the ID 'R1' as the OUTPUTS help states, or a help describing the index

notes: Reproduction: m = createModel({'R1','R2','R3'}, {'','',''}, {'a[c] -> b[c]', 'b[c] -> ', 'c[c] -> '}, 'grRuleList', {'g1','',''}, 'printLevel', 0); addReaction(m, 'N1', 'metaboliteList', {'a[c]','b[c]'}) -> 'Index exceeds array bounds.' (line 341); m.subSystems{1} = {'Glyc'}; r = addReaction(m, 'R1', 'lowerBound', -5); r.subSystems{1} -> {''}. Quarantine scope: defect 1 is confined to the name/value form 'metaboliteList' without 'stoichCoeffList' (the deprecated positional form with a single cell stops earlier with 'Missing stoichiometry information'); grep of src calls found none using that form. Defect 2 is reached only when the rxnID is already in the model and 'subSystem' is not given (depends on data; callers that only add new reactions do not reach it). The lead should decide whether callers are blocked for it. Other observations, not recorded as defects: in the deprecated positional form with a cell metaboliteList, an invalid value (e.g. reversible 'x') makes inputParser fail and the failure is swallowed (lines 219-225), the value is ignored and the reaction is added (input not allowed by the help); lines 387-392 swallow any error of extendModelFieldsForType with disp('test') (VII-C, reachable only with a malformed model); 'notes' is accepted but never used; with the legacy subSystem field a new reaction does not extend subSystem. No legacy test dedicated to addReaction exists (many tests call it alongside other functions).
confirmed_by: lead, 2026-11-25: code read (addMultipleReactions: exist(varargin) always true, so lines 100-115 never run; line 222 reads the old model.rules; addMultipleReactionsIT is byte-identical; addReaction: line 183 reads the legacy subSystem field, so line 307 resets subSystems; metaboliteList without stoichCoeffList has no default), writer reproduced each in MATLAB; default reach (the duplicate-ID and subSystems defects depend on data, not on the call form; 1 of 119 addReaction calls passes subSystem)
